title: Plan and usage
description: Read-only limits for the {plan} plan. Existing work remains available if a limit is reduced.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can view plan and usage details.
planNotConfiguredBody: Ask the platform administrator to assign a plan.
effectiveSince: Effective since {date}. New allocations stop at 100%; nothing is deleted automatically.
howLimitsWorkBody: Workspaces cover active brand workspaces. Users include active members and pending administrator invitations. Social profiles have both an agency-wide total and an individual cap for each network. AI requests and tokens reset monthly; storage is cumulative.
requestBody:
Hello,

Agency name:

Reason:
supportRequestsBody: Ticketed asks from a platform administrator to view your agency's content. Approving creates a time-limited grant; rejecting closes the request without a grant.
supportEmptyBody: No platform administrator has filed a support access request for your agency.
